laws.rule: Only tractors, invalid carriages (mobility scooters), construction vehicles and combine harvesters may be driven on Sark's roads (Motor Vehicles (Sark) Law 2013); there are no cars or taxis. Visitors may apply for a temporary mobility-scooter licence. No motor vehicle may be imported without the Road Traffic Committee's permission.

money-and-cost.currency: pound sterling (GBP); Guernsey pound notes and coins also circulate
money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: Currency: reference sources describe the Guernsey pound as a local issue of sterling notes and coins, in currency union with the UK since 1921, and Sark as using sterling; no Sark or Guernsey government page confirming this was read, so treat it as a signal. Cash declaration: the States of Guernsey page says anyone entering or leaving the Bailiwick of Guernsey with cash worth GBP 10,000 or more, in any currency, must declare it at a Customs red point. GBP 10,000 is about A$19,019 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = GBP 0.5258). That page doesn't name Sark, so check how it applies to travel to and from Sark.
